en:
A sound piece of work that covers the basics.
Widely available on the market.
note: Shared by Tanto, Wakizashi, Kodachi, Katana, Long Sword, Tachi.

en:
Combines a weapon's performance with beauty.
Its edge lives up to its looks.
The broad blade suits heavy blows more than cutting.
The slim blade suits thrusting more than cutting.
A tanto modeled on the armsmith Kunimitsu. A well-balanced blade.
A tanto modeled on Yoshimitsu, swordsmith and bowyer. Light and easy to handle.
A tanto modeled on the master swordsmith Masamune. A keen and beautiful blade.
A wakizashi modeled on the armsmith Magobei. Light and easy to handle.
A wakizashi modeled on Yoshimitsu, swordsmith and bowyer. A well-balanced blade.
A wakizashi modeled on the armsmith Muneshige. A keen-edged blade.
A kodachi modeled on the armsmith Muneshige. Light and easy to handle.
A kodachi modeled on the master swordsmith Masamune. A keen and beautiful blade.
A kodachi modeled on the armsmith Kunimitsu. A well-balanced piece.
An odd-shaped sword, deeply curved, half of it double-edged. Very light. Kunimitsu's finest.
A light, handy sword with a lovely hamon. Modeled on Magobei's most inspired work.
A wakizashi stronger than a tachi. It carries on swordsmith Yoshimitsu's secret arts.
A kodachi with a striking, mirror-bright blade. It revives Muneshige's most guarded secrets.
An unsigned sword rusted down to little more than scrap. Useless as it is, but...

A perfectly straight tachi with no curve.
Often used for iai, the quick draw.
A stately tachi with a thick blade. A groove makes it lighter than it looks.

A sword with a hamon like great surging waves.
Fairly powerful.
The straight Hidden Blade reworked with a curve, giving it a keener edge.

A sword modeled on the swordsmith Osafune.
A tachi of bold, imposing form.

A slender, beautiful tachi.
Light, easy to handle, and powerful too.
A blade engraved: "Let all who go to battle stand at the front of the ranks."
Modeled on swordsmith Yoshimitsu's late work. Seemingly unfinished, yet very powerful.

A mighty sword reforged from the Denta.
Very powerful and well balanced.

A long sword made as long as a spear.
Powerful, but hard to handle.
Carries on master swordsmith Masamune's secret arts. Flawless in power and beauty.
Masamune's inspired blade. So ominously keen it was renamed Muramasa to ward off evil.

A cursed blade of terrible power.
Its steel is said to be always wet...
A sword as light as a tanto. Its maker is unknown, but the style recalls Yoshimitsu.
A tube on the shaft lets it extend and retract at will. Good in close combat, too.
A Kuda Yari with a stronger shaft that extends and retracts smoothly.
A short spear with a huge spearhead.
A naginata with a reinforced shaft.
A nagamaki with a reinforced shaft.
Spearsmith Kunimitsu's secret naginata. Its secret manual suggests it is unfinished.
Spearsmith Magobei's secret nagamaki. Its secret manual suggests it is unfinished.
The Kuda Yari of its creator, Ito Suketada. The most perfected form of the type.
A kind of Ryokama Yari with a cross-shaped head. The head is of the ginkgo type.
A kind of plain spear, with a blade-shaped head.
An Omi Short Yari with a longer shaft.
A spear with a head shaped like a bamboo leaf.

A spear with a sickle on one side of the head.
The head is of the ginkgo type.
A spear with sickles on both sides of its head. The sickles curve upward.
An advanced Tsukushi Yari. Built for thrusting, with a reinforced shaft.
A spear of the Hozoin school, with crescent-shaped sickles.
A long spear modeled on the spearsmith Osafune. Mass-producible, yet very powerful.
note: [edit: 'the spearsmith', as in the other 'modeled on the X' smith descriptions]

en: A long spear modeled on the spearsmith Muneshige. Mass-producible, yet very powerful.
note: [edit: 'the spearsmith', as in the other 'modeled on the X' smith descriptions]

en: The finest of the bamboo-leaf spears. Said to cut even a dragonfly landing on its tip.
The finest spear with a flat triangular head. A refined Omi Yari, drawn to its full potential.
A naginata that carries on Kunimitsu's secret arts. A hollow shaft makes it lighter.
A nagamaki of Magobei's secret arts. A famed spear said to be long enough to cut the moon.
A small wooden bow. It has little draw strength, so its power is low.

A small bamboo bow.
Being small, it lacks power.
A Small Bamboo Bow strengthened with a rattan wrapping.
note: Sm.Rattan Bow; Small Bamboo Bow = full form of the item name Sm.Bamboo Bow (D0086).

en:
An improved Small Wood Bow.
Even so, its power is still low.
note: Wood Bow; Small Wood Bow = full form of Sm.Wood Bow (D0085).

en:
The standard type of bamboo bow.
Many improved types build on it.
A Bamboo Bow wrapped in rattan, then lacquered over for strength.

An improved Wood Bow, made larger still.
It has fair power.
A 3-Ply Bow wrapped in rattan, then coated in black lacquer for strength.

A Bamboo Bow reinforced with 4-year bamboo.
It lacks stability.
A 2-Ply Bow reinforced with 3-year bamboo. The bow is sandwiched in 4- and 3-year bamboo.
A 3-Ply Bow further reinforced with 3-year bamboo. More powerful, and very stable.
An enlarged Bamboo Bow reinforced with green bamboo. Pushes its materials to the limit.
A Large Bamboo Bow wrapped in rattan, then coated in red lacquer for strength.
note: Lg.Shigeto Bow; Large Bamboo Bow = full form of Lg.Bamboo Bow (D0096).

en: A bow with a "ki" device to draw the string. Powerful, but heavy and inaccurate.
An improved 4-Sided Bow, with more spring.
An improved Crossbow. More powerful, but inaccurate and heavy.
A Chinese crossbow. Same as the Large Crossbow, but with a longer range.
The crossbow as it is made in the West. Powerful, but inaccurate and heavy.
A Wood Bow squared off and encased in bamboo. Springy and powerful.
Yoshimitsu's masterpiece as a bowyer. Range, power and all else are flawless.
A rapid-fire Chinese Crossbow. Powerful, but inaccurate and heavy.
A rapid-fire Nanban Crossbow. Great range and power, but inaccurate and heavy.
note: Nanb.Rep.Xbow; Nanban Crossbow = full form of Nanb.Crossbow.

en: A replica of the bow said to have been used by Nasu no Yoichi. Light and accurate.
A replica of the bow said to have been used by Minamoto no Yoshiie. Flawless range and power.
A bow said to have been Xiang Yu's. Incredibly powerful for a bow, but very heavy.

A high-performance version of the Yoichi Bow.
Very easy to handle.
